name: Yampa River Fund grants
summary: A basin-wide community fund that pays for river restoration, riparian and in-channel habitat work, and water leases to support river flows in the Yampa Basin. Nonprofits, public bodies and irrigation entities apply in an annual spring cycle.
reporting: Programmatic and financial progress report every 6 months, plus a final report with a financial report.

eligibility.rule: Supporting a science-based project classified in one listed project pool
Keeping a multi-year or multi-phase project within three years

documents: Letters of support from affected project area landowners and/or water users

opens.quote: The Spring 2026 grant cycle opens FEBRUARY 17, 2026

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include state and local government entities, public districts and irrigation entities, mutual ditch companies, homeowners associations, and non-profits.

access.quote: Grant applications will be received through Yampa Valley Community Foundation.

administered_by.quote: Grant applications will be received through Yampa Valley Community Foundation.

reporting.quote: The applicant shall provide the YRF a programmatic and financial progress report every 6 months

effort.quote: All applicants for Yampa River Fund grant awards are required to conduct a 15-minute consultation with the Yampa River Fund manager to review eligibility and project details.
Applicants will be expected to meet with a joint Steering Committee/Advisory Technical Committee meeting to answer questions on the afternoon of May 7.

eligibility.quote: Support science-based projects classified in one of the project pools listed below.
multi-year or multi-phase projects are allowed but cannot exceed three years.

documents.quote: Provide project budget, timeline, evaluation and monitoring plan, and letter(s) of support from affected project area landowners and/or water users.
